name: Momos
oneLiner: AI guest experience platform for multi-location restaurant brands: AI agents, review management, a Unified Inbox, surveys, recovery and insights.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant brands that want guest support, reviews and recovery handled across every location from one place.

updates.text: 2025 releases included AI copilots, AI ticket summaries, AI brand guidelines, mobile-first reports, and integrations with Paytronix, Square and Otter.
Potbelly partnered with Momos in 2025 to bring reviews, cases and guest messages across 472 locations into one view.

features: Alfie, the Experience Agent, replies to guests in minutes, remembers visit history and preferences, and is trained on the brand voice.
Alfie issues points, coupons and offers directly from the loyalty platform.
Works across website chat, in-app support, surveys, delivery apps and inbound enquiries, with escalation to the team when needed.
Unified Inbox centralizes Google reviews, App Store feedback, social DMs and POS data, with AI triage and smart routing.
Papa Murphy's: $2M+ in recovered revenue via offers and 97.7% automation of review replies, across 1,000+ locations.
notes: Dropped the old claim about Burger King, Shake Shack and 30,000+ locations: not on momos.com. momos.com says 20,000+ locations and 600+ brands.
